about: Vane Manor's hall, a room file v2 (the format: the builder's README, room files). Metres in the room's frame: x east, y north, z up, the floor's centre on the origin; 26 x 14 m inside (x -13..13, y -7..7), 3.6 m high. Every prop, spot, portal and night light of packages/content/data/scenes/manor_hall.json is named below. The scene's two partitions (round 8J) are furniture: a library wall of seven real-size bookcases on row 6 and five glazed Vane Tin Co. cases on row 10, the dining bay between them. The curtain alcove in the south-east is walled at its back and on its west side by one wall-piece (G21, decision D5). The stairs up to the upper floor are a visible flight rising south from the north wall through a hole in the ceiling (decision D6). Grey boxes stand in for the pieces that have no model yet (decision D2). A key named note, or <key>_note beside <key>, is a comment.

Along the north wall the flight would stand on the clock (west) or the safe (east), so it rises south into the hall from the north wall, on tile column 13 (x -1..0) beside the spawn: a house flight (0.2 m risers, 0.25 m treads), its first riser on the north wall, through a hole in the ceiling (y 2.75..5.0: the tread 2.0 m from the base is the first under the hole, 2.0 m under the ceiling; the tread past 4.25 m stands over the ceiling) and on 1.0 m above it into the dark. Its foot is beside the marker, (0.5, 7.0), 0.5 m from the flight; the flight's run ends at y 2.75, 1.0 m short of the bookcases' fronts.
